breakdown.title: The Horse of Ice
breakdown.logline: A young woman walks to the far end of a room and returns with a block of glittering ice replacing her head, which melts and carves itself into a beautifully molded horse's head.

colours.value: clear ice with glittering highlights, otherwise unremembered

texture.value: glittering, smooth, clear ice, with carved detail

breakdown.world_logic: A person's head can become a block of ice that melts and sculpts itself into a horse's head, and this is accepted as natural.

geography.value: a room with an autoclave near where they stood, and a far end

scenes.title: The Room
scenes.mood: calm, natural, like watching a carving rather than something alarming

moments.action: The dreamer and the young woman stand talking by the autoclave.
moments.visual_point: The young woman and the dreamer by the autoclave.

moments.action: The young woman excuses herself and walks off to the far end of the room.
The young woman stands with an irregular block of glittering ice set upon her shoulders in place of her head.
moments.looks_at: the autoclave side of the room
moments.visual_point: The ice block replacing her head.

leaves.now: an irregular block of glittering ice

moments.dream: a head replaced by a block of ice

moments.action: The ice starts to melt and trickle, little channels form, the angles round away, and the sculpturing goes on rapidly.
moments.feeling: like watching carving, not falling apart
moments.visual_point: The ice melting into channels and rounded shapes.

states.now: an irregular block of glittering ice

moments.action: It becomes a beautifully molded head of a horse, eyes, ears and nostrils faithfully carved out in the clearest ice, replacing her head.
moments.visual_point: The clear ice horse head, where her head was.
moments.dream: a horse's head of clear ice replaces her head

breakdown.title: The Sofa Roller Coaster
breakdown.logline: At a movie theater with sofa seating, the dreamer watches a huge neighboring sofa turn into an ordinary amusement park roller coaster, amazed but uneasy.
breakdown.world_logic: A movie theater has blue sofa seats and one side is free, a sofa turns into a roller coaster and the dreamer accepts it.

geography.value: indoors, rows of seats facing a screen, with one side of seating

landmarks.value: blue sofa seats instead of normal seats, a large sofa next to the dreamer's sofa

appearance.value: the sofa the dreamer and girlfriend are sitting on
taller sofa next to the dreamer, before turning into the roller coaster

scenes.title: Theater with sofa seats
scenes.mood: uneasy, but amazed when the sofa transforms

moments.action: The dreamer and their girlfriend sit on a blue sofa in a movie theater filled with people sitting on blue sofa seats instead of normal seats. A large sofa stands next to them, taller than theirs.
moments.feeling: uncomfortable, something off because one side is free
moments.visual_point: blue sofa seats in a theater and a big sofa next to the dreamer

moments.action: The large sofa next to the dreamer turns into a roller coaster, like a real one from an amusement park. The dreamer looks amazed at it.
moments.visual_point: the sofa transformed into a roller coaster
